items: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: new-user free quota is 1 million tokens per eligible model for 90 days, Singapore region only; listed models include qwen4-max, qwen3.8-max, qwen3.8-flash, qwen3.8-27b, deepseek-v4.1-flash and glm-5.3.

OpenRouter: baidu/ernie-5.5-flash-preview:free and inclusionai/ling-3.2-flash:free are listed among current :free models.
NVIDIA Build / NIM: free hosted endpoints include moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro and z-ai/glm-5.3-flash. The free endpoint for deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash is listed as deprecated.
Tencent Cloud TokenHub: official OpenAI-compatible base URL added. Claiming or enabling a model freezes $30 for Hunyuan language models and $10 for other language models.
SiliconFlow: official pricing FAQ states new accounts can start with $1 in free credits. Latest DeepSeek V4, Qwen 3.8, GLM-5.3 and Kimi models are listed at paid per-token rates.
ModelScope API-Inference: usage is deducted in Magicubes; concurrency is dynamically adjusted; official examples include Qwen3.5 models.
Re-verified all listings against official pages; removed 6 dead or paid-only providers (Flexlora, FreeTheAI, Teapot Router, YepAPI, Mango Inference, Novita AI).

Updated Aion Labs (Stripe card check), Bay of Assets -> Routeriva, rout.my (650K tokens/day), Mervex (200 RPD), AIHubMix (12 -free models), UnoRouter (144 :free), xKiro (26 free models), Ramp Router ($500 credits), Vireonix (20M in/200K out per hour), BlazeAPI (free.blazeapi.org), Bytez, Cerebras, Hyperbolic, Cohere, Hetzner, AnyAPI, Onomeo, Gonka Broker, Agnes AI, DreamPrompting, APIBridge, BazaarLink, and OrcaRouter.
Added 9 verified providers: AxForge, BlockRun, BeatAPI, Merkium, LLMTR, cheapllm.shop, SimpleLLM, PLaMo API (Preferred Networks), and SEA-LION API (AI Singapore).
100milionseek: 400M tokens/day milestone window ended 19:14 UTC on 20 Nov 2026; allowance is back to 100M tokens/day.
Maritaca AI: S5-free is no longer listed on official pricing; API models are billed per token.
Ant Ling: Ling-3.2-flash launch free window was 2 weeks from 5 Nov 2026; official pricing updated 19 Nov 2026 lists paid rates. A remaining free-quota amount is not published.
Inception (Mercury): API remains available through 28 Dec 2026 and will not be served after that date.
IteraCompute: free Auto access for new users ends 08:00 UTC on 24 Nov 2026.
APInex: daily free allowance now 25M tokens/day, unlocked by a single $5+ top-up; free tier 15 RPM.
Cloudflare Workers AI: 10,000 Neurons/day resets 00:00 UTC; nine models now need paid billing.
OpenRouter: free-model limits are 20 requests/min and 50/day; 1,000/day after at least 10 credits purchased.
Z.ai: GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash are free; GLM-5.3-Flash is paid.
Vercel AI Gateway: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free has been free since 14 Oct 2026; a separate credit amount is not published.
IteraCompute: cutoff restated as 08:00 UTC on 24 Nov 2026; one request at a time; max output 8,192 tokens.
Offer type badges now use Free forever, Free credit, and Free with paid plan.
Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Gemini Decision 1 now listed as free of charge on the Free Tier (Nov 2026).
Added optional free_type, phone_required and data_training fields, plus filters, a public JSON schema, and copy-paste starter snippets.
AI21 Labs Jamba API retired on 9 Aug 2026; free trial gone.
Ollama Cloud no longer has a free cloud tier (pay-as-you-go per token).
Added Hetzner Inference API (free while experimental).
Added Lightning AI Model APIs (signup credits).
Added Tencent EdgeOne Makers Models (500K free tokens/month on 9 built-in models).
NaraRouter Free plan cut from 3 models to 1 (laguna-s-2.1); still 7M tokens/day, 15 RPM.
BazaarLink free models down from 7 to 6.
NaraRouter free models cut from 5 to 3 (still 7M tokens/day, 15 RPM).
Rechecked Infron, Token Harbor and AMD Token Factory docs.
Added GW BUS, EURI by Euron, APIBridge, rout.my.
APInex free allowance cut from 10M to 3M tokens/day.
Added Aion Labs, Frenix, MixRoute, Bay of Assets / Routeriva.
Added Router9, Ramp Router, Bytez, ModelScope API-Inference.
Added OpenCode Zen, Electron Hub, Pollinations.
BazaarLink free list grew from 2 to 7 models.
Added Vikasit AI, xKiro, BlazeAPI, CrowLLM.
Added AIHubMix, Routeway, Clean APIs, Agnes AI, AMD Radeon Cloud Token Factory, Vercel AI Gateway.
Hugging Face free monthly credits ended; SambaNova Free needs card + purchase; Fireworks signup credit removed.
NaraRouter free models cut from 10 to 5.
Added FreeTheAI, Requesty, Kilo Gateway, OVHcloud AI Endpoints.
Added Gonka Broker, FreeAIapikey, Vireonix, Infron, Token Harbor.
APInex free rate dropped to 5 RPM per IP.
Added DreamPrompting, LLM7.io, AnyAPI, Y-API daily key.

sites.notes: Open-source model router. Free catalogue lists many or/*:free models plus nvidia/deepseek-v4-flash and openpaths/free. No card for free routes.

sites.name: LLM EU
sites.free_allowance: $5 promotional inference credit per new organisation; expires in 90 days; one grant per org
sites.notes: European catalogue/router. Partner endpoints (including OpenRouter rows) may need policy turn-on. Card payments not enabled on this deployment.

sites.name: Boundless API
sites.free_allowance: $5 signup bonus (Starter model pool); may expire after 30 days if unused
sites.limits: Starter pool rate limits; tokens/day unspecified
sites.notes: Unified router for Claude/GPT/Gemini and curated models. Billing policy also notes a 5% platform fee on credit purchases after the bonus.

sites.name: LLMCloud
sites.free_allowance: $1 free credits on signup; no card required
sites.notes: One OpenAI-compatible key across 150+ models with auto:cost / auto:quality / auto:reasoning routing. Signup page states free $1 credit.

sites.name: Nscale
sites.free_allowance: $5 free starter credit for new accounts (stated in docs changelog for Serverless Inference and Fine-tuning); quickstart says early users may be eligible
sites.notes: UK AI cloud OpenAI-compatible serverless inference. Google SSO signup. Confirm free credit still appears in console on signup.

sites.name: Maritaca AI
sites.free_allowance: DROPPED: S5-free is no longer listed on official pricing. API models are billed per token (S5 is R$0.50 input / R$2.50 output per 1M tokens).
sites.notes: Brazilian Sabiá/S5 API. Official API and pricing pages (including maritalk-api docs) no longer list S5-free. Paid S5 remains available. Base URL from Maritaca API docs / community examples.

sites.name: EXAONE API Platform (LG K-EXAONE 2.5)
sites.free_allowance: K-EXAONE 2.5 API free to use with an API key (announced 9 Nov 2026); no quota published
sites.notes: Official LG AI Research. Model k-exaone_v2.5, 512K context, Korean/English text only. Rate limits and end date not published.

sites.name: Regolo.ai
sites.free_allowance: 30-day free trial, 1M tokens/day on all Core models
sites.notes: Italian EU hosting. Trial ends after 30 days, then pay-as-you-go. Model multipliers affect how fast the daily allowance is used.

sites.name: FreeInference (Harvard MadSys Lab)
sites.free_allowance: Free for research/education, 'generous' quota, tokens/day unpublished
sites.notes: Email signup. OpenAI and Anthropic compatible endpoints. Research lab, so avoid private data.

sites.name: Inferbase
sites.free_allowance: Free plan: 5,000 requests/month, 100 managed requests and $0.50 model usage/day on models up to $2/M output tokens
sites.limits: 60 RPM per key, 10 RPM managed, 8,192 in / 1,024 out tokens per request
sites.notes: Gateway with smart routing; tokens/day unspecified (daily cap is in dollars).

sites.name: Hyperbolic
sites.free_allowance: One-time $1 credit after phone verification (unlocks inference on Free Tier); credits never expire once bought
sites.limits: 300 requests/min per API key; tokens/day not published
sites.notes: Relaunched serverless API; old api.hyperbolic.xyz is retired. Text and vision models only. Each phone number works for one account.

sites.name: ArcaneAPI
sites.free_allowance: $10 free credit on signup, 53 models
sites.notes: Multi-model gateway, OpenAI-compatible format per its page; base URL not stated on homepage. Young unofficial gateway.

sites.name: 1vy
sites.free_allowance: $1 free credit on signup, 100+ models on one key (15% markup after)
sites.notes: Unofficial multi-model gateway.

sites.name: NovAI
sites.free_allowance: $2 signup credit after email verify; 5 free Zhipu Flash models (glm-4.7-flash etc.)
sites.limits: 10 free-model calls/day, 5 RPM before first top-up
sites.notes: Gateway relaying Chinese providers; no daily token figure published.

sites.name: Zro (MoonMath)
sites.free_allowance: Free plan: daily usage on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash only (GLM-5.3 Flash no longer free)
sites.notes: Daily amount not published; zero request retention; EU/US inference.

sites.name: Vectoree
sites.free_allowance: $5 one-time welcome credit after CLI login and project link; then pay-as-you-go wallet
sites.notes: Agent backend with OpenAI-compatible Model Gateway (36+ models, vectoree/auto). Credit is one-time, not daily; empty wallet stops the gateway.

sites.name: GonkaRouter
sites.free_allowance: 1M free tokens one-time for new accounts (email or Google sign-in)
sites.notes: Router on the Gonka network; GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, MiniMax-M2.7. Also Anthropic-compatible. One-time grant, not daily. Blog mentions a $20 credit campaign that the pricing page does not confirm.

sites.name: Speka
sites.free_allowance: Free plan includes $1 of model usage each month and access to all open catalog models
sites.limits: 10 requests/minute and 1 API key on the Free plan
sites.notes: Official site says prompts are not used to train models. A gateway: do not send private data if that is a concern.

sites.name: Braintrust
sites.free_allowance: Starter plan is $0/month and includes $10 of model credits each month for built-in models
sites.limits: Monthly credits do not roll over. On Starter, built-in model use pauses after credits unless a card is added for on-demand usage
sites.notes: Official examples still use this OpenAI-compatible proxy URL; docs also note the proxy page is deprecated and that requests now route to Braintrust's gateway.

sites.name: Liquid AI
sites.free_allowance: Limited-time $2 in free API credits for new accounts (stated on console.liquid.ai)
sites.limits: Per-model request and token limits are listed in Liquid Console, not as a single public number
sites.notes: Official docs say chat models speak the OpenAI API. The $2 new-account credit is described as limited-time on the console.

sites.name: Together AI
sites.free_allowance: Ternary Bonsai 27B (Prism-ML/Ternary-Bonsai-27B) is listed as Free for input and output on the serverless models page
sites.limits: No fixed public RPM for this model; official rate-limit docs say limits may apply under high demand
sites.notes: Other Together serverless models on the same page are priced per token. Confirm the current Free listing before you rely on it.

sites.name: NLP Cloud
sites.free_allowance: Free plan can test the I models without a credit card. The pay-as-you-go plan adds an initial $15 credit and requires a card
sites.limits: Official FAQ says throughput on the Free plan is very limited; no public numeric cap was found
sites.notes: Uses NLP Cloud's own API, not an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. The $15 credit applies only to pay-as-you-go.

sites.name: IBM watsonx.ai
sites.free_allowance: Free plan: up to 300,000 foundation-model tokens per month, up to 20 CUH of machine learning tools, and up to 100 documents for text extraction
sites.limits: Monthly Free-plan caps above; a tokens-per-day figure is not published
sites.notes: Dallas service URL is from IBM Cloud API Docs; other regions have their own hosts. A simple OpenAI-compatible base URL was not clearly published on the pages checked.

sites.name: AMD Token Lab
sites.free_allowance: Complimentary Token Lab points for free AMD AI Developer Program members (10 points, 30-day access per AMD dev community)
sites.limits: About 20 RPM per key; points drawn per model rate; access extendable once by 15 days
sites.notes: Open models on AMD GPUs: DeepSeek V4, Qwen3.8, Gemma 4, GLM-5.3. AMD publishes no point amount on the program page.

sites.name: NFlashX
sites.free_allowance: $1 welcome credit on signup (first 100 accounts) plus free-tier Flash model
sites.limits: Flash model 2 req/min on free, 4K output
sites.notes: Small new multimodal API (chat, image, video) by NowayDev; credit capped per network.

sites.name: Qora API
sites.free_allowance: $5 trial credit on request (email support or DM @QoraAPI); not automatic
sites.limits: Pay as you go after; $50 minimum top-up
sites.notes: API relay gateway, 350+ models, also Anthropic-format at https://qoraapi.com.

sites.name: Baichuan AI
sites.free_allowance: ¥80 one-time signup credit (about 10M Baichuan2-Turbo tokens), valid 3 months
sites.notes: China-based platform; Chinese-language console.

sites.name: Baidu Qianfan
sites.free_allowance: 1M free tokens each on 17 models (ERNIE 4.5, DeepSeek, Qwen3, Kimi K2), one-time, valid 3 months
sites.notes: Online inference only, not batch. China-based platform; Chinese-language console.

sites.name: 100milionseek
sites.free_allowance: 100M tokens/day on deepseek-v4.1-flash-free
sites.limits: Up to 5 concurrent requests; resets 00:00 UTC
sites.notes: Unofficial DeepSeek relay. Email + human check. The 400M tokens/day milestone window ended 19:14 UTC on 20 Nov 2026; the standard allowance is 100M tokens/day. Official homepage presents sign-up as available.

sites.name: Synap
sites.free_allowance: 100,000 tokens/day and 50 requests/day for the first 7 days, then 50,000 tokens/day and 10 requests/day on qwen3-coder-30b
sites.limits: 10 requests/minute per key; 4,096 max output tokens; allowance resets 00:00 UTC; shared per account and per network address; global free cap
sites.notes: Also has an Anthropic-style /v1/messages endpoint. Sign-up is Google sign-in or an email magic link. The free model is qwen3-coder-30b.

sites.name: Flonno
sites.free_allowance: $1 one-time credit on signup after email verification (qwen3.8-27b)
sites.notes: Single model (qwen3.8-27b). Also offers an Anthropic Messages subset on the same base.

sites.name: HPC-AI Model APIs
sites.free_allowance: $2 one-time free credit (voucher claimed in Models Console)
sites.limits: 5 RPM per model before first deposit (L0)
sites.notes: Launch promotion; claim the voucher in the Models Console. Credit spends at model list prices.

sites.name: DGrid
sites.free_allowance: dgridai/free model: 10 requests/min and 100 requests/day. After a qualifying top-up of $5 or more: 20 requests/min and 1,000 requests/day.
sites.limits: Per account. Standard access without a $5+ top-up is 10 requests/min and 100/day; increased access is 20/min and 1,000/day.
sites.notes: The dgridai/free model id routes each request to available free capacity; the underlying model may change. A qualifying top-up is a direct addition of funds to the account balance.

sites.name: Nebius Token Factory
sites.free_allowance: $25 Token Factory credit after email verification, claimed through the Nebius Builder Program.
sites.notes: The Builder Program is free to join. Partner offers have their own terms. Open models are listed in the Token Factory catalog.

sites.name: ReadyServer LLM API
sites.free_allowance: Included with a paid ReadyServer VPS at no extra charge, with no per-token billing.
sites.limits: Context 131,072 tokens for qwen3.6-27b and 262,144 tokens for qwen3.8-27b, including output. Capacity is shared; when busy, requests are queued and customers who have used fewer tokens are served first.
sites.notes: The endpoint is reachable only from a ReadyServer VPS over the private network, not from the public internet. No API key; if a client requires one, any placeholder works. Models: qwen3.6-27b and qwen3.8-27b. Official FAQ says prompts and responses are not logged or used for training. Also offers an Anthropic Messages endpoint.

sites.name: Scaleway Generative APIs
sites.free_allowance: Serverless free tier: 1,000,000 tokens and 60 minutes of audio transcription.
sites.notes: Usage beyond the free tier is billed. A project-specific base URL of https://api.scaleway.ai/{project_id}/v1 is also documented. Official pages do not publish a reset period for the free tier.

sites.name: Aiven AI Gateway
sites.free_allowance: The aiven-model router is free. Approved organizations also receive $300 in credit during early access.
sites.notes: Access is requested in the Aiven Console and approved as capacity allows. During early access, usage is free and nothing is invoiced. Named models are billed at the rates shown in the model list. Also supports the Anthropic SDK at https://ai.aiven.io.

sites.name: Volcengine Ark
sites.free_allowance: Per-model free inference quota for new users. The amount is not published; it is shown in the console.
sites.notes: The free quota is per model and is shared under the main account. It applies to pay-per-token online inference, not batch inference, plugins or knowledge bases. China-based platform.

sites.name: Zhipu BigModel
sites.free_allowance: GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4-Flash-250414, GLM-Z1-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash are free. GLM-5.3-Flash is paid (¥0.8 input / ¥2.8 output per 1M tokens).
sites.notes: China platform, distinct from Z.ai. Official OpenAI-compatible base URL is https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4. Other free models are listed on the official pricing page.

sites.name: Ant Ling
sites.free_allowance: Ling-3.2-flash was free for the first 2 weeks after the 5 Nov 2026 launch. Official pricing last updated 19 Nov 2026 lists ¥2 input / ¥6 output per 1M tokens. A remaining free-quota amount is not published.
sites.notes: The API is also compatible with the Anthropic protocol. Before the first API call, bind an Alipay account and activate the Ling service; only personal Alipay accounts are supported for payment. The official FAQ still describes a free quota that can reset the next day, but does not publish the amount.

sites.name: Logfare
sites.free_allowance: Free inference on Standard models. Premium and Pro models are also free after optional consent (training opt-in for Premium; training and data-sale opt-in for Pro).
sites.limits: New accounts (first 24 hours): 10 requests/min, 200/hour, 500/day, 2 concurrent. Regular accounts: 40 requests/min, 1,000/hour, 5,000/day, 6 concurrent. Shared network/IP: 320 requests/min, 8,000/hour, 40,000/day. Limits use fixed UTC windows.
sites.notes: Also supports the Anthropic Messages API and the OpenAI Responses API. Discord membership is required to keep API access. Requests are logged by default; evaluation-dataset use can be opted out at /consent. Use logfare/auto or GET /v1/models for current model IDs.

sites.name: A4F
sites.free_allowance: Free plan: limited models, unlimited validity
sites.limits: 5 requests/min and 300 requests/day; context is limited to about 50%
sites.notes: Unified gateway that proxies requests to many providers. Model IDs use a provider prefix, for example provider-1/chatgpt-4o-latest.

sites.name: Kimi (Moonshot)
sites.free_allowance: RMB 15 voucher for new users who register with a mainland China mobile number and complete real-name verification. Valid 3 months from the issue date.
sites.notes: China platform. Official docs say the voucher can be used on Kimi K3 and Kimi K3.1 Pro, and cannot be used on Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed. The API is also Anthropic-compatible at https://api.moonshot.cn/anthropic. The international developer API on platform.kimi.ai is a separate product and is not covered by this voucher.

sites.name: iFlytek Spark
sites.free_allowance: Spark Lite (model id lite) is listed as free to use. A free quota can be claimed on the product page. The amount is not published.
sites.limits: Lite max input 8K tokens and max output 4K tokens. A daily amount is not published.
sites.notes: Official OpenAI-compatible HTTP API. Claim the Lite free quota and an APIPassword from the iFlytek console. Other Spark versions (Pro, Max, Ultra) are billed separately.

sites.name: Xiaomi MiMo
sites.free_allowance: New-user bonus credit that can offset pay-as-you-go API usage. The amount is not published and varies by campaign. Bonus credit is valid for 40 days.
sites.notes: Official OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible API. Sign-in uses a Xiaomi account. Eligibility and credit amounts vary by campaign. Example model id in official docs: mimo-v2.6-pro.

sites.name: AxForge
sites.free_allowance: 3M serverless tokens every 30 days
sites.limits: Shared across serverless models (Qwen3.8 27B, GLM-5.3-Flash, MiMo-V2.6-Flash, Qwen3.8 Flash Next)
sites.notes: Requires a card check (nothing charged). Hosted in the EU (Stockholm); zero prompt retention, not used for training.

sites.name: BlockRun
sites.free_allowance: Keyless free open-weight models (9 models with billing_mode: free, incl. Nemotron 3.5, Muse Glimmer 30B, Laguna XS 2.1, North Mini Code, MiniMax M3.1 Flash)
sites.notes: No API key or account needed for free models. Paid models use x402 USDC. Free-tier prompts may be used by upstream hosts to improve their service.

sites.name: BeatAPI
sites.free_allowance: Free -free models (glm-5.3-flash-free, deepseek-v4.1-flash-free, hy4-flash-free) on a zero balance
sites.limits: 1 successful request/min per account before first top-up (up to 10/min after top-up)
sites.notes: Zero balance allowed; no top-up required. Daily allowance not published.

sites.name: Merkium
sites.free_allowance: Permanently free API access on 7 models (ganymede-1.1, pluto-1.2-flash/pro, pluto-1.1-flash/pro, ceres-1.0/pro)
sites.limits: 30 requests/min per API key (space requests at least 2s apart)
sites.notes: Independent model developer; no billing step. Conversations are never used for training.

sites.name: LLMTR
sites.free_allowance: Free models on a zero balance (incl. qwen3.8-27b-free, nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free, nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b, lfm3-1.7b-free, k-exaone-2.5)
sites.limits: Daily allowance amount not published; new accounts have a lower cap for 24h
sites.notes: Turkish gateway; some free rows have end dates or one-time allocations. Prompts on free rows may be retained by upstream providers to improve models.

sites.name: cheapllm.shop
sites.free_allowance: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 free during beta (no token quota); 5,000 input + 1,000 output tokens/hour free after beta
sites.limits: 1 concurrent request per account; no RPM/TPM cap during beta
sites.notes: Also Anthropic-compatible at https://cheapllm.shop. Prompts and answers are not stored.

sites.name: SimpleLLM
sites.free_allowance: Free models (free-gemma-4-E4B, free-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) at 0 credits
sites.notes: Hosted in Germany by Stage One Solutions UG.

sites.name: PLaMo API (Preferred Networks)
sites.free_allowance: Free plan (Japan residents/entities) + plamo-3.0-fin-beta free of token charges on any plan
sites.limits: 100 RPM on plamo-3.0-prime family; 50 requests/24h on plamo-3.0-fin-beta
sites.notes: Free plan registration is limited to Japan residents/entities, and Free-plan inputs/outputs are stored and used for training.

sites.name: SEA-LION API (AI Singapore)
sites.free_allowance: Free Trial API key for SEA-LION models (e.g. aisingapore/Qwen-SEA-LION-v4.5-27B-IT)
sites.limits: 10 RPM per user; 1 API key per account
sites.notes: Sign in with Google via SEA-LION Playground.

sites.name: One AI API Key
sites.free_allowance: $10 one-time sign-up credit plus 57 free ($0) model ids sharing 100 requests and 5,000,000 tokens/day per account
sites.limits: 100 requests/day and 5M tokens/day shared across free ids; resets 00:00 UTC
sites.notes: Google sign-in. Reseller gateway (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM and more); also Anthropic-format base https://api.oneaiapikey.com. Free ids are $0 while the promotion runs.

sites.name: FreeModel
sites.free_allowance: 1M tokens/month on the Free plan, all 29 catalog models
sites.limits: Up to 60 RPM; monthly reset; tokens/day unspecified
sites.notes: Email, Google or Telegram sign-in; keys start with fm_. Reseller gateway listing Claude/GPT/Gemini/DeepSeek models; paid plans via UPI or USDT.

sites.name: Plugsky
sites.free_allowance: Free plan $0: 100 requests and 50,000 tokens/day on plugsky-micro / plugsky-lite (accounts created from 2 Nov 2026)
sites.limits: 1 concurrent request, 30 RPM, 32K input / 2K output per request; resets 00:00 UTC. Older accounts keep 500 requests / 250K tokens per day until migration.
sites.notes: Free tier uses Plugsky's own engine models only; full catalogue is paid.

sites.name: Dahl Inference
sites.free_allowance: 100 million tokens one-time gift at signup (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, MiniMax M2.7)
sites.limits: Signup tokens burn after 7 days without a request; allocate tokens to a key at /account (new key starts at 0)
sites.notes: Gateway to the Gonka decentralized GPU network; username-only signup; top-ups in crypto.

sites.name: Kiosapi.id
sites.free_allowance: Free models (e.g. Gemma 4 26B, SEA-LION 27B, Qwen3 30B, Llama 3.1 8B) at 50 requests/day without top-up
sites.notes: Indonesian gateway; email verification required; paid models billed in rupiah.

sites.name: MegaNova
sites.free_allowance: Tier 1 (free registration, no card): Manta Mini 1.0 and Manta Flash 1.0 at 50 requests/day each, plus other per-model daily free quotas
sites.limits: Per-model requests/day; daily quotas reset 00:00 UTC; tokens/day unspecified. A $1 deposit unlocks Tier 2 quotas.
sites.notes: Free quota is per model, for evaluation and interactive use.

sites.name: Moark (Gitee AI)
sites.free_allowance: 100 free calls/day per account across featured models via the free experience token
sites.notes: Gitee's model platform (formerly Gitee AI); Gitee login. Models marked free separately require a purchased resource package.

sites.name: Wallaby
sites.free_allowance: $0.50 one-time free credit (no card, no top-up, never expires)
sites.notes: Australian gateway reselling Kimi K3 / K3.1 Pro below official list price; also Anthropic-compatible.

sites.name: Packet.ai Token Factory
sites.free_allowance: Input and output tokens are $0 until 16 Dec 2026 00:00 UTC
sites.limits: Per-account request, token and concurrency caps are shown in the dashboard; daily and monthly token allowances are not published as fixed numbers
sites.notes: Open-weight models on Packet GPUs: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, MiniMax M3.1 Flash and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. Email or Google signup and one SMS verification. After 16 Dec 2026 00:00 UTC, usage is billed per token.

sites.name: Qiniu Cloud Conatus Free
sites.free_allowance: 100 million tokens/day after real-name verification (1 billion/day after a single top-up over RMB 100)
sites.limits: Campaign model qiniu/conatus-free only; quota is shared by all keys on the account, resets at 00:00 China Standard Time, unused quota does not roll over. Campaign runs through 30 Nov 2026 15:59 UTC.
sites.notes: Official Qiniu Cloud limited-time fusion model. Login and real-name verification are required. The higher daily cap needs a single completed top-up over RMB 100; in-quota calls do not deduct account balance. After the campaign ends, the model stops rather than converting to paid usage.

sites.name: Sarvam AI (Token Factory)
sites.free_allowance: ₹100 signup credit for every verified user, never expires, usable across Sarvam APIs including Token Factory
sites.limits: Plan rate limits are shown in the dashboard; tokens/day not published
sites.notes: Official Token Factory serves Sarvam 105B and open-weight models such as GLM-5.3 Flash, Gemma 4 31B and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Credits are billed at each model's published per-token rates in INR.

sites.name: AI Horde
sites.free_allowance: Free up to a dynamic output allowance: 4,096 tokens when eligible workers are idle, down to 512 tokens when estimated wait reaches 5 minutes
sites.limits: Tokens/day not published. The anonymous key 0000000000 is accepted; a request above the free output allowance is refused. Registered users with kudos may request longer outputs.
sites.notes: Volunteer-run distributed inference network with an official OpenAI-compatible chat front. No signup is required for anonymous use. Available models depend on which workers are online.

sites.name: LLM.kiwi
sites.free_allowance: Free to use; no credit card
sites.limits: Rate limits return HTTP 429; numeric tokens/day and request caps are not published and may change
sites.notes: OpenAI-compatible gateway with model auto-routing. The models endpoint lists auto plus named models such as Nemotron 3 Ultra, Nemotron 3 Super and MiniMax M2.5. Create an API key in the dashboard.

sites.name: APIsFreeLLM
sites.free_allowance: 10 million tokens/day or 10,000 requests/day per IP, whichever comes first
sites.limits: Per IP: 1 request/s, 2 in parallel, 32,000-token context, answers up to 16,000 tokens; daily caps reset at 00:00 UTC. No API key or signup.
sites.notes: Hosted open-weight chat model free-ai (about 35B parameters). If a client requires a key, any placeholder string works.

sites.name: Sail Research
sites.free_allowance: $5 per month in free credits on the Free plan after a payment method is attached
sites.notes: OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses APIs, plus Anthropic Messages at https://api.sailresearch.com. Official model list includes GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3.1 Pro at published per-token rates.

sites.name: Cerebellum
sites.free_allowance: $5 signup credit, never expires
sites.limits: Tokens/day not published. Billing is per token by model size class; idle time, storage and GPUs are not charged.
sites.notes: Import open-weight models from Hugging Face, S3 or GCS to get an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Listed bases include Qwen3.8 27B, Gemma 4 31B and Llama 3.1 8B Instruct. Official page says prompts and outputs are not stored or used for training.

sites.name: Tinker (Thinking Machines Lab)
sites.free_allowance: Inkling 2 Mini free-tier model ID is priced at $0 for prefill, sample and train, with a 64K context limit
sites.limits: Free training and sampling are subject to rate limits that are not published as fixed numbers. Prepaid accounts must have a positive balance to use the free tier.
sites.notes: Official OpenAI-compatible inference. Free model ID: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini:peft:65536:free. A production inference base URL is documented separately at https://inference.thinkingmachines.dev/prod/oai/api/v1.

sites.name: Infomaniak AI Services
sites.free_allowance: 1M free credits, then pay as you go
sites.limits: Tokens/day not published. The product_id is retrieved with GET /1/ai.
sites.notes: Swiss-hosted official OpenAI-compatible API. Account setup asks for a valid payment card. Official FAQ says queries are not recorded or used to train models. The published grant is described as 1M free credits, not as a tokens/day figure.
